The value of colligative properties of colloidal solution are of small order in comparison to those of true solution of same concentration because of colloidal particles are comparatively less in number.

These observations prove that the Light is made of particles. The energy of the particle increases with the frequency.

F=-2kx⇒a=-2kmx,

Comparing it witha=-ω2x , we get

ω=2km=2×202

=20 rad s-1

questions.q: As shown in the figure, a combination of a thin plano-concave lens and a thin plano-convex lens is used to image an object placed at infinity. The radius of curvature of both the lenses is 30 cm and refraction index of the material for both the lenses is 1.75. Both the lenses are placed at distance of 40 cm from each other. Due to the combination, the image of the object is formed at distance x= ______ cm, from concave lens.
questions.solution:
Using Lens Makers formula for the plano-concave part, we can write

1f1=(1.75-1)-130

⇒  f1=-40 cm

Using Lens Makers formula for the plano-convex part, we can write

1f2=1.75-1130⇒ f2=40 cm

Image from first lens will be virtual and on the left of first lens at focal length 40 cm. So the object for second lens will be 80 cm from second lens which is 2f2. Final image is formed at 80 cm from second lens on the right.
So, x=120.

When the sheet is heated to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>177</mn><mo> </mo><mo>°</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math>, the change in the diameter of hole is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>d</mi><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math> . ⇒d'-d0=5×1.6×10-5×177-27

Hence, required value of d=12.
